resources.string: Saved instructions apply to future calls. All active instructions are sent to Volcengine when an AI call session is prepared, even if the call is not answered. Caller statements do not change them.
Add what the assistant may say and what it needs to ask. Changes apply to the next call.
Delete this instruction? It will no longer apply to future calls.
Could not save. Your draft is still here.
A courier or delivery driver calls
Ask where the parcel is and whether a callback is needed. Do not invent an address or grant access.
A customer asks about a product, service or appointment
Ask what they need, quantities or preferred times, and a contact method. Take a message without committing to a price or appointment.
Review the reply and keep the instruction under 800 characters before saving.
